scientific_integrity: Direct finite-field subspace character calculation supplies the infinite-family proof; numerical tests support it. No independent mathematical audit or historical-priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the matrix-rank metric on M_{m,3}(F_q), m>=3, is analyzed. The bibliographic source Delsarte (1978) has month/year but no verified day of first public appearance; the earliest day-verified motivating public source is Li--Weston, arXiv:0901.0695v1, 2009-01-06. A general equivalent formulation in older association-scheme literature could imply the explicit formulas. Four exhaustive finite examples are checks, not an all-parameter proof.
title: Sharp negative type and endpoint Hilbert dimension of rank-three bilinear-form graphs
